notes.title: Introducing Cairn
notes.content:
Hi everyone! 

It is finally time for us to let you in on what we've been cooking: our next game Cairn, a mountain ascent adventure with an intuitive climbing simulation. 

Read the whole description here - also see the superstars who have joined our team to make this game! 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1588550/Cairn/

We have created a new climbing simulation that gives you complete freedom to explore the mountain, read the rock face and decide on your route. Climbing is challenging, with difficult sections to navigate, and you will need to use your equipment and pitons wisely. Cairn’s story mode will take you on Aava’s journey, as she sets to conquer a summit no one has  reached before, and you will decide what she’s ready to sacrifice to achieve the ascent.

[previewyoutube=nhyMWuORSuA;full][/previewyoutube]

We'll share more with you soon, but in the meantime [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1588550/Cairn/]wishlist Cairn[/url] and stay tuned by: 
[list]
[*] Joining us on [url=http://discord.gg/thegamebakers]Discord[/url]
[*] Joining our (very occasional) [url=https://bit.ly/NewsletterTGB]newsletter.[/url] 
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/23727865/6d60c64cf78b1f2fcd7b371b9fdcecf1b1a41ec1.jpg[/img]

After years of secrecy, it feels really good for the whole team to finally be sharing this with you, and we can’t wait to hear your feedback - and show you more!

Until then,
The Game Bakers

notes.title: Furi Invincible mode lets players focus on the story or practice their run
notes.content:
We are happy to bring an update to Furi on Steam: the [b]Invincible mode[/b]

In the vein of [i]Soma[/i]‘s Safe mode or [i]Celeste[/i]’s Assist mode, the [b]Invincible mode[/b] is great for players who want to overcome a challenging fight to enjoy the audiovisual and narrative experience that is Furi.
But it’s also perfect for gamers who want to practice their fight, in particular speedrunners looking to improve their record!

We’ve also added a [b]new control scheme[/b] that was directly inspired by discussions with gamers from this community.

The [u]update is free[/u], and a Steam Daily Deal is bringing the game at 7,99 $ / € (-60%) starting at10AM PST / 19h CET today.

More information below and  in the forum. 
Let us know your feedback!
- Audrey for The Game bakers

[h1]Update content[/h1]

[list]
[*] The Invincible mode: a set of commands that can be used to become invincible, skip a fight, skip or lock a certain phase in a fight, or weaken a boss. The feature can be used in Story mode by players who want to focus on the narrative and audio visual experience without worrying about the challenging fights. It enables players to skip completely a boss or just a difficult phase. But it can also be used by experienced players to practice their skills, in particular by speedrunners looking to improve their time on specific combat phases. 

[*] Control Scheme D: an alternate control scheme, that helps dodging or parrying while shooting/slashing, and was designed based on discussion with the game community.
[/list]

https://steamcommunity.com/app/423230/discussions/0/1734336452597182781/

notes.title: Furi Physical Edition and Making Of
notes.content:
We’re delighted to announce today a [b]few surprises[/b] that we hope will please Furi’s fans:
[list]
    [*]Furi is getting a [b]physical collector edition for PC[/b]
    [*]Last episode of [b]Making of Furi[/b] is out, and the series of 4 episodes is on Steam.
    [*]The award winning Furi [b]soundtrack[/b] will be available in CD.
    [*]A special [b]promotion[/b] on Steam marks the day, with an all time low discount of -40% on everything Furi. 
[/list]

[h1]FURI DEFINITIVE EDITION INDIEBOX[/h1]
Furi Definitive Edition includes the game and its DLC One More Fight, as well as the soundtrack. It's made in collaboration with the folks at IndieBox. It will be available in June.

The IndieBox edition includes a blu-ray case with the game, a CD with the original soundtrack, a 24-pages manual, a sticker and an artwork card with the code to get the game and its DLC on Steam. The game requires Steam to function. You can pre-order it here: https://www.theindiebox.com/product/furi-definitive-edition
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/23727865/1eba0538dac19f24e17d7213b713d74a78e69464.png[/img]
 
[h1]FURI MAKING OF[/h1]
Making of Furi is a series of mini-documentaries on the making of boss-fight game Furi by The Game Bakers. Director Katya Mokolo followed the team over two years, from conception to launch. Each of the 4 episodes focuses on a different aspect of the game development.
Episode 4 dedicated to the music of the game just launched today. 

The series Making of Furi is available for free on Steam: http://store.steampowered.com/app/629150

Episode 4 on The Game Bakers’ Youtube: https://youtu.be/JojUipY0aoo


[h1]FURI SOUNDTRACK ON CD[/h1]
The award winning soundtrack of the game, explosive mix of original compositions by electro / synthwave magicians Carpenter Brut, Danger, The Toxic Avenger, Lorn, Scattle, Kn1ght and Waveshaper has been a record seller digitally and in its deluxe double vinyl edition. The soundtrack will be made available as a deliciously retro CD, in a sleek digipack.
You can pre-order the CD here: furi.bandcamp.com. For the occasion the digital version of the soundtrack is 30% off on Bandcamp and 40% of on Steam, down to 10$/€.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/23727865/c09dab8621c0605a21353b96c9ceda984ca6daaa.png[/img]

This pack features:
- A complete new fight against The Flame
- In a new arena designed for this bossfight
- Playable in Furi and Furier difficulty modes
And that’s all, or is it?

The additional content is accessible directly from the main menu.

notes.title: Furi update - Version 1.3.73
notes.content:
Hi Furi players, old ones and new ones!

We just released a new update, with some new and neat options:
- Render quality options (may improve performances for lower configurations, give in a try in the options menu)
- HUD position option (if your HUD is vertically cropped on your display)

Thank your for playing Furi and for loving it so much!
Cheers,
The Game Bakers.

notes.title: Furi major update with new features and bug fix - v1.2.58
notes.content:
We're happy to release [b]Furi's first major update[/b].
We've been listening to the feedback from the community and have added some of the most requested features as well as fixed bugs here and there to improve the experience.

Here is the content of [b]version 1.2.58[/b]

[list]
    [*]Alternate gamepad control schemes
    [*]New radial mode option for mouse aiming (default)
    [*]Added Steam Trading Cards (waiting for Steam validation)
    [*]Tweak for Promenade mode (added more variety to the Promenade fights)
    [*]Slight nerf for The Burst and The Line (in Furi difficulty story mode only - NOT in Speedrun mode)
    [*]Added hint for Automove (press X to walk on paths to arena)
    [*]Fixed most cases where The Burst walls raise below Rider
    [*]Improved reticle visibility on some levels (re difficulty to see it for colorblind people)
    [*]Misc bugfixes
[/list]

We hope you enjoy this update and we'll keep listening to your feedback and bug reports.

The forum link is here: http://steamcommunity.com/app/423230/discussions/0/350542683195320704/

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/23727865/5a6714d3cac373bf25a2af07a6ad83bbad57f6c9.png[/img]

notes.title: Furi major update with new features and bug fix - v1.2.58
notes.content:
We're happy to release [b]Furi's first major update[/b].
We've been listening to the feedback from the community and have added some of the most requested features as well as fixed bugs here and there to improve the experience.

Here is the content of [b]version 1.2.58[/b]

[list]
    [*]Alternate gamepad control schemes
    [*]New radial mode option for mouse aiming (default)
    [*]Added Steam Trading Cards (waiting for Steam validation)
    [*]Tweak for Promenade mode (added more variety to the Promenade fights)
    [*]Slight nerf for The Burst and The Line (in Furi difficulty story mode only - NOT in Speedrun mode)
    [*]Added hint for Automove (press X to walk on paths to arena)
    [*]Fixed most cases where The Burst walls raise below Rider
    [*]Improved reticle visibility on some levels (re difficulty to see it for colorblind people)
    [*]Misc bugfixes
[/list]

We hope you enjoy this update and we'll keep listening to your feedback and bug reports.

The forum link is here: http://steamcommunity.com/app/423230/discussions/0/350542683195320704/

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/23727865/5a6714d3cac373bf25a2af07a6ad83bbad57f6c9.png[/img]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/23727865/85ad2e5851ed41626e7adafba648f904896adf14.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Bug reporting, known issues and patch
notes.content:
Thank you all for your support and your patience with the bugs reported.
Just wanted to make sure you all know the following:
[list]
    [*] We have updated Furi on July 14th with some [u]important bug fixes[/u] (version 1.1.49). In particular fixed R2 sensitivity, added R1 for charged shots, fixed some bugs with Burst and Scale, etc. More info here: http://steamcommunity.com/app/423230/discussions/0/366298942101758722/

    [*] We have an [u]FAQ/Known issues[/u] page on 
http://www.thegamebakers.com/furi-faq-known-issues/

    [*] If you have seen a problem, let us know in the [u]forum[/u] here:
http://steamcommunity.com/app/423230/discussions/1/
[/list]

Thanks for your help!
